heading: Delays for which no responsibility is assumed
lead: The Commission is not responsible, and may not consider any claim, for demurrage or delays caused by—

tree.text: necessary construction or maintenance work on Canal locks, terminals, or equipment;

investigation of a marine accident that is conducted within 24 hours after the accident occurs, except that any liability of the Commission beyond that 24-hour period shall be limited to the extent to which the accident was caused, or contributed to, by the negligence of an employee of the Commission acting within the scope of the employee’s official duties; or
except as specially set forth in this subpart, any other cause.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1985—Par. (6). Pub. L. 99–209 amended par. (6) generally. Prior to amendment, par. (6) read as follows: “time necessary for investigation of marine accidents; or”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1985 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 99–209 applicable to any claim arising on or after Dec. 23, 1985, see section 7(b)(1) of Pub. L. 99–209, set out as a note under section 3771 of this title.
